classification.difficultyReason: Normalise three differently stated work rates to bookshelves per hour, add them, calculate the time for eight bookshelves and convert to the nearest minute.

content.prompt:
Mr Ding, Ms Fu and Mrs Falconer are organising the maths textbooks in the 8 bookshelves in the staffroom. Mr Ding by himself would take 25 hours to do all 8 bookshelves. Ms Fu can organise 2 bookshelves in 7 hours. Mrs Falconer can take 11 hours to organise 3 bookshelves.

How long will it take if they work together? Answer to the nearest minute.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Combined rate}&=\frac{8}{25}+\frac{2}{7}+\frac{3}{11}\\\text{Combined rate}&=\frac{1691}{1925}\text{ bookshelves/hour}\\\text{Time for 8 bookshelves}&=8\div\frac{1691}{1925}\\\text{Time for 8 bookshelves}&=\frac{15400}{1691}\text{ hours}\\\text{Time in minutes}&=\frac{15400}{1691}\times60\\\text{Time in minutes}&=\frac{924000}{1691}\text{ minutes}\\\text{Time in minutes}&\approx546\text{ minutes}\end{align*}$$
Therefore, they take **9 hours 6 minutes**, to the nearest minute.
